$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Booking details
job: One booking after it is made: when it is, where it stands now, who it covers and how to open each pass. The same page serves the booking through its whole life; the state changes the content, not the layout.
useFor: Any single booking, permit or reservation with a time and one or more people.
notFor: A package made of several bookings (use Booking details · package). The step that creates the booking.

allowed: Toolbar · Secondary Pages / Default: back, the service name as title, support.
forbidden: A title that changes with the state.

allowed: Day and date, one status line in plain words, and at most one action that fits the state (CTA · Primary MD).
forbidden: Urgency wording about an approaching time.

allowed: Headers · 04 Legend, then MemberCard per person: name, identifiers, and either a CTA · Secondary XS that opens the pass or a StatusChip.
forbidden: A pass action on a cancelled or missed booking.
Full ID numbers shown to people other than the holder or the booker.

allowed: One CTA with Fate for cancel, or one Secondary for change, only while the service allows it.
forbidden: A cancel action after the visit.
Cancel styled as the main action.

allowed: SectionTitle with cards-slider: guidance first (MediaCard · Article), then at most one paid service (MediaCard · Ticket).
forbidden: Paid cards on a cancelled or missed booking.
Paid cards inside a suppression window.
Prices without currency and what they cover.
A sticky action bar: the page is a status page, not a step.

states.changes: Summary: the chosen time. People: open pass. Manage: cancel or change.
Summary: a calm line and one helpful action (guide, directions). People: open pass. Manage: cancel while allowed.
Summary: a closing line and, where it exists, one action for the record (certificate). People: no pass action. No manage.
Summary: the original time. People: Cancelled chip, per person when only some were cancelled. No manage. No paid cards.
Its own state and chip, not Cancelled. Summary says what happens next and whether a new booking is possible.

rules: One layout for every state; only the content of spaces 1 to 4 changes.
The status is said in words and with a chip, never by colour alone.
Completion is acknowledged calmly: no celebration, no score, no emoji; faith wording only in its natural place.
Passes open in one tap and work offline once issued.
Digits 0–9; dates in one format across the page; Arabic and English both checked.

allocation.App level: L3 · reached from the request card on Today, from Requests, and from the notification.
allocation.Band: Band 2, commitment state. T1 when the time is near.
allocation.Suppression: The page itself is never suppressed. Space 4 follows the commercial rules: withheld in sacred windows.
allocation.Withheld: Dependents see their own pass and the time; manage (space 3) belongs to the booker or the organiser.

measure.success: Pass opened before the visit; visits kept
measure.guardrails: cancellations, missed visits, support contacts from this page

allocation.Service: Umrah Permits · DNA Core. Its booking state is commitment state: band 2, T1 when the time is near.

example.inTheFlowToday: The toolbar title changes by state. Person cards are hand-built, not MemberCard. The status line carries an emoji and a raw %s. "Visit Missed" shows a Cancelled chip and sits under "Cancel by user". The same action is worded two ways across screens. Frames are named "Compeleted".
